Priya (CSM): Quick sync 15m: client Onyx showing erratic token bursts during nightly syncs. Need 30/90 trend + 2 low-risk mitigations for QBR.
Jordan - FinOps: pulling usage slices now, will post summary link.
Sam (SE): Observed parallel embed jobs + retry storms. Suggests adding per-job backoff + persistent embedding cache.
María (Acct Owner): Client plans a data backfill in 4 days. theyre worried about surprise overages.
Priya (CSM): Can we cost-estimate: (A) per-route soft cap + webhook alert, (B) 8-bit embed model + cache?
Jordan - FinOps: Quick calc: cap + alert reduces worst-case daily spend ~28%. 8-bit embeddings adds ~22% savings assuming warm cache. ETA: EOD.
OpsBot: Onboarding status: Onyx -> Staging, last activity 2 days ago.
Sam (SE): I'll craft a sample guardrail YAML and a small log detector. snippet:
```bash
redwood usage detect --pattern "bulk_index" --min-concurrency 16
```
Priya (CSM): Good. Owners: Jordan -> numbers + slide, Sam -> guardrail config + test plan, María -> confirm backfill window with client. 9am PT sync tomorrow to finalize QBR bullets. :white_check_mark:
